exposure: induction of labour for non-urgent indications at 37-39 weeks gestation
gestational age at induction (37-38 weeks vs 39 weeks)
cohort: Over 200,000 births from 19 hospitals across the US from 2002 to 2008
finding: Preventive induction of labor for non-urgent indications at early term may be associated with a decreased risk of cesarean delivery but increased risks of adverse neonatal outcomes at 37 weeks.
